assets.purpose: 高级当代植物编辑摄影主视觉，一枝深紫鸢尾与长叶，竖3:4
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium contemporary botanical editorial photographic asset, portrait 3:4, image only.
A single deep-purple iris bloom on one slender stem, accompanied by one long green iris leaf, photographed as a carefully art-directed botanical portrait. Real macro photography: exquisite natural petal texture, veins and delicate partly translucent folds, deep plum and violet petals with small honest golden details at the flower center, finely observed organic edges. Minimal warm cream to very pale blush-pink studio backdrop, subtle natural tonal depth and quiet negative space. The single flower has a precise recognizable silhouette and rests in an asymmetrical composition with the stem and the one long leaf providing a long elegant line. Premium contemporary independent art-journal photography, sensitive controlled sidelight, beautiful but believable real botanical detail, sharp flower with gently softer stem depth. Leave breathing room for an editable cover crop. Do not create three flowers, a bouquet, a full-field floral pattern, stickers, watercolor, gouache, pastel painting, faux paper texture, heavy grain, excessive props or dramatic fake shadows. No text, no labels, no letters, no logos, no frame, no watermark. Portrait 3:4.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium independent coffee-brand editorial photographic asset, landscape 4:3, image only.
A deliberate top-down photographic still life: dark brown-black brewed coffee in one small round off-white porcelain cup, on an architectural geometric tabletop composed of deep olive-green and graphite-gray planes. A very sparse arrangement of a few warm yellow-orange coffee cherries or roasted beans adds a tiny warm color counterpoint. Angled late-afternoon sun creates one or two precise confident shadows and reveals the crisp geometric surface boundaries. Bold useful negative space across part of the image, art-directed placement rather than a centered stock-photo grouping. Sophisticated contemporary editorial product photography, real ceramic rim, glossy dark coffee surface, restrained subtle tabletop finish, high-end material detail without fake roughness. Palette: warm off-white cup, near-black coffee, dark olive and graphite with tiny yellow-orange accents. Do not include green mugs, kraft coffee bags, potted plants, hands, people, bags, piles of beans, marble luxury clichés, many random shadows or rustic cafe props. No text, no letters, no logos, no labels, no watermark. Landscape 4:3, top-down view.
